document: Dual-AI agreement reconciliation for Batch93 six KUs under the unified six-line convention (TJPAI/pai-word Issue #1, revised 2026-10-25, unified notice 2026-10-26; the old four-line wording is void). This file does not re-certify content and does not publish anything: it reconciles the two existing independent reviews, records zero divergences, and hands the six items to the main-dev line for isolated integration testing.

convention.rule: Two independent AI judgments; dual approval passes; divergences rechecked per item only; no extra Staging/RC/Release/re-review gates; passed batches roll to main dev without waiting for the full 20K; engineering QA (runtime correctness, UI/SRS regression, preview protection) belongs to main dev, not to language certification.

anchors_verified_this_session.qa_branch_head_subject: qa(core20k): record B218 six-KU teaching review and answer policy without release approval

identity_registration.note: Identity recording for these six is closed via this separate registered crosswalk. The legacy tools/core20k_lexicon/runtime/v1/identity-crosswalk.json reviewed array remains empty; main dev must consume the registered crosswalk, not wait for the legacy file.

muse.scope: Per-item semantic certification with criteria C1 sense fit, C2 example discrimination against every sister KU, C3 translation, C4 POS and Cambridge US IPA, C5 Cambridge evidence grade, C6 teaching value

chatgpt.scope: Semantic review, example-translation review, per-item Chinese answer policy

fresh_consistency_check_this_session.method: Muse judged the six pack items from the pack text alone (gloss, example, translation, prompt, answer), then compared with the two reviews above.
fresh_consistency_check_this_session.answer_policy_agreement: agrees with B218 policies on all six items
fresh_consistency_check_this_session.role: Consistency check only; the dual-AI pair is the B216 Muse review and the B218 ChatGPT review. This check does not add a third vote and does not change either review.

per_item.note: Singular count reading in 'One person is waiting outside'; sister morphology KU excluded by ku_type.
'Need more time to finish' is amount-of-duration only; 时长 accepted in duration context, never as point-in-time or count.
Possession of information ('I know the answer'); acquaintance sense (认识) correctly excluded by the object.
Collective plural in 'Many people live here'; nation/community sister sense excluded by context.

Habitual conversing ('We talk every evening'); noun/formal-discussion sisters excluded by verb form and context. IPA: teaching /tɑːk/ is General American; Runtime /tˈɔk/ differs; do not mutate Runtime; teaching audio uses the pack value.
Directional 'come here' = 到这里; locative 在这里 acceptable as paraphrase of the same place sense; discourse 'at this point' sister excluded.

dual_ai_language_verdict.meaning: Both independent language judgments approve all six items. Under Issue #1 this is the language-certification outcome; it is not a publication approval.

reclassification_of_b218_conditions_per_.grading_implementation: Main-dev engineering task, not a language blocker. It applies only if a typed-answer path actually exists; the current flow is self-assessed. Main dev demonstrates positive/negative tests if and when it builds that path.
reclassification_of_b218_conditions_per_.source_attestation_refetch: Not re-fetched in this reconciliation either, stated honestly. Pack dictionary URLs are cited in the pack; re-fetching them is an optional attestation step, not a language-certification gate under Issue #1.
reclassification_of_b218_conditions_per_.legacy_sense_id: Already handled: formal binding uses KU_ANCHORED_SENSE with official_sense_id null; the pack's legacy sense_id must never be treated as Runtime authority.
reclassification_of_b218_conditions_per_.deployment_and_publication: Separate main-dev gates. This manifest does not grant them.
